career_ladder.note: Assistant Engineer (Electrical / Civil / Telecom) is the foundational executive engineering cadre in the Transmission Corporation of Andhra Pradesh Limited (APTRANSCO). Officers manage extra-high-voltage (EHV) grid substations (132 kV, 220 kV, 400 kV) and transmission line corridors. Promotions are governed by Regulation 14(a)(1) and Regulation 6(b) of the APSEB Service Regulations (Parts II & III) as adopted by APTRANSCO, requiring passing of prescribed departmental accounts tests.

exam_scheme.note: The recruitment examination for Assistant Engineers is conducted as a single-stage written test consisting of 100 objective multiple choice questions carrying 100 marks over a 2-hour duration (120 minutes). Section A tests core discipline engineering knowledge (70 marks) and Section B covers general aptitude and awareness (30 marks). There is no negative marking. Final selection is based 100% on written test merit, followed by original document verification.

financial_package.note: Engineers are remunerated under the Andhra Pradesh Power Utilities Revised Pay Scales (agreed upon via bipartite wage settlements between power utilities management and employee unions). The revised entry pay scale for Assistant Engineer is ₹63,600 - ₹1,31,220 with an entry basic pay of ₹63,600 (replacing the pre-revised scale of ₹41,155 - ₹63,600).
